technical_summary: POC targets: index 3,000,000 SKUs (text + metadata + 200KB image features per item). Retrieval layer: 768-d embeddings, HNSW index sharded by region; candidate set 100 -> rerank with cross-encoder (distilled model) as second-pass. Latency SLOs: median <= 80ms, p95 <= 180ms, p99 <= 320ms under normal load. Peak seasonal target: sustain 200–400 qps with graceful fallback to cheaper reranker or cached results. Cost constraints: combined retrieval+rerank target <$0.003/query at baseline; must present scenarios for 3x and 10x traffic. Data residency: EU customers must be served from eu region; audit logs retained 12 months.
performance_targets: throughput_target: 200 qps baseline, 1,500 qps peak (Black Friday modelled)

Deliverables: perf matrix, cost model, failure-mode playbook, recommended routing and quantization profile.
